welcome: Party communication fixes, plus an important notice about current WoW Forever messaging problems.

sections.title: Important: WoW Forever messaging issues
items: We're aware that addon messages in WoW Forever are being delayed and sometimes failing to arrive. This can leave party data loading or make map markers and announcements unavailable.

We suspect heavy load on Blizzard's servers is contributing, but the cause has not been confirmed. This update fixes several QuestTogether communication problems; it cannot guarantee delivery when the game's messaging service is disrupted.

sections.title: More reliable party quest data
items: Party Quest Log and Party Objective Tracker now exchange party quest data through the party, raid or instance channel. Update together so both sides use this route; older versions remain compatible but may still reply by whisper. Comparisons with players outside your group still use whispers.
Requests that WoW definitively rejects now stop waiting instead of leaving party data loading for minutes.

Moving away from or switching between hovered quests no longer leaves unfinished transfers occupying response slots and blocking later requests. Old response copies are also cleared when space is needed.

sections.title: Clearer communication diagnostics
items: Definitive send failures now reach WoW's Lua error handler for bug-catching addons and are recorded in QT's diagnostics and debug log. Repeated identical errors are limited; normal throttling and uncertain send results are not treated as hard failures.
If party data remains stuck, /qt diagnostics now includes more detail about message routes, send outcomes and pending requests to help us investigate.
